description: Replace Angular project scaffolding with React 19 + Vite + TypeScript project setup. Remove all Angular-specific config and dependencies, set up Vite build tooling, Vitest test runner with React Testing Library, and React Router v7. Preserve the public/favicon.ico and global styles.
steps: Remove Angular-specific config files: angular.json, karma.conf.js, tsconfig.app.json, tsconfig.spec.json. Keep tsconfig.json but rewrite it for React/Vite.

Remove all Angular and Karma/Jasmine dependencies from package.json. Add React 19.x dependencies: react, react-dom, react-router-dom (v7). Add dev dependencies: @vitejs/plugin-react, vite, typescript, vitest, @testing-library/react, @testing-library/jest-dom, @testing-library/user-event, jsdom, @types/react, @types/react-dom.
Create vite.config.ts with React plugin configuration.
Rewrite tsconfig.json for React+Vite (jsx: react-jsx, moduleResolution: bundler, target ES2022). Create tsconfig.node.json for Vite config.

Replace src/index.html: move to project root as index.html (Vite convention), update to include
and .
Create src/main.tsx as React entry point that renders <App /> into #root with BrowserRouter.

Create a minimal src/App.tsx placeholder that renders a
App
for now.
Create a vitest setup file (src/setupTests.ts) that imports @testing-library/jest-dom.
Update package.json scripts: dev -> vite, build -> tsc -b && vite build, preview -> vite preview, test -> vitest run.
Remove the old src/main.ts, src/app/app.config.ts Angular entry points.
Preserve src/styles.css (global styles) and import it in src/main.tsx.
Run npm install to install all new dependencies.
Run npm run build to verify the Vite build works with the minimal App placeholder.
Run npm test to verify Vitest runs (no tests yet, should exit cleanly).
acceptance_criteria: All Angular-specific files (angular.json, karma.conf.js, tsconfig.app.json, tsconfig.spec.json) are removed
No Angular or Karma/Jasmine dependencies remain in package.json
React 19.x, react-dom, react-router-dom v7 are in dependencies
npm run build succeeds without errors
npm test runs Vitest without configuration errors
src/styles.css global styles are preserved and imported
verification: Run npm run build and confirm exit code 0
Run npm test and confirm Vitest runs without configuration errors
findings: tsconfig.json needed 'exclude: [src/app]' to prevent TypeScript from compiling old Angular files in src/app/ (kept for FEAT-002). Vitest config needed 'exclude: [src/app/**, node_modules/**]' to skip old Angular spec files, and 'passWithNoTests: true' since no React tests exist yet. Both npm run build and npm test exit with code 0.
